release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.28 (Build 28) - Chat List Screen Enhancements:
- Added tabbed interface with 'All Chats' and 'Groups' tabs for better organization
- Enhanced chat list filtering - separate search for individual chats and groups
- Improved real-time message updates with immediate UI refresh and sorting
- Enhanced update check system with manual check icon in AppBar (Android)
- Automatic update check on app startup with rate limiting
- Better chat sorting by newest message timestamp (handles both sent and received)
- Improved unread count tracking and display
- Enhanced empty state messages for both tabs with contextual actions
- Better group chat detection and filtering
- Responsive tab bar design for all screen sizes
- Improved search functionality with tab-specific hints
- Enhanced real-time synchronization for chat list updates
- Better timestamp parsing and display across different date formats
- Various UI/UX improvements and bug fixes
